remarks:
Welcome to 1 Cambridge Ct. in Lancaster’s sought-after Windsor Ridge neighborhood. Beautifully maintained and thoughtfully updated, this 4-bedroom, 2.5-bath home sits on a large, fully fenced lot with a pond and wooded backdrop that gives the backyard a private feel.
The first floor offers a layout that makes for great entertaining including 2 sets of sliding glass doors that make indoor/outdoor living a breeze. The living room and dining room flow into the remodeled kitchen, featuring white cabinetry, granite countertops, a large center island and Bosch appliances. Just off the kitchen, the step-down family room is a comfortable place to gather, with a fireplace and large windows that bring in plenty of natural light while overlooking the backyard and pond. Whether you’re hosting a holiday, having friends over for the game or just spending a quiet night at home, there’s plenty of room to spread out without losing that connected feel. Upstairs are four bedrooms (2 currently being used as home offices), including a spacious primary suite with a tray ceiling, private bath and custom closet. The additional bedrooms offer flexibility for family, guests or a home office, and second-floor laundry means no hauling baskets up and down the stairs. The backyard is one of the highlights of this home. Fully fenced with plenty of room to play, entertain or simply enjoy the outdoors, it feels surprisingly private thanks to the pond and wooded view beyond. The custom-built TimberTech deck extends the living space outside and includes a hot tub—the perfect spot to relax at the end of the day or enjoy the changing seasons.
A two-car attached garage provides plenty of space for vehicles, lawn equipment, bikes and additional storage. Located in the Lancaster School District and close to shopping, restaurants and everyday conveniences, 1 Cambridge Ct. offers the space, updates and setting that are hard to find all in one home. Meticulously cared for by its current owners, this is a home that is truly ready for what comes next. See attachments for full list of upgrades, Showings begin Wednesday October 7th and offers will be reviewed as they are received.
